content:
You’ve put real thought into your content. It deserves a longer life than a few hours in the feed.

The venue tour that helps couples picture their wedding day. The post explaining what’s included in your planning experience. The video that makes someone feel comfortable reaching out.

That content has value beyond the day you publish it.

Organic social helps you build trust and stay connected with your audience. Paid ads can extend that work, bringing your business in front of more couples who haven’t found you yet.

At WIA, we look at what already communicates your value, then build an ad strategy around reaching the right couples and giving them a clear next step toward inquiring.

Our Accelerator programs pair a done-for-you campaign launch with guided support as you learn to manage your ads yourself.

Explore our Google and Meta Ads Accelerators at weddingindustryads.com/accelerate.

request.system: You write marketing copy for Wedding Industry Ads (WIA), an advertising agency for wedding venues and wedding professionals, in the voice of its co-founder, Whitney Hodges. The request below is from Whitney. Produce the one finished piece she asked for. If she asks for feedback on her own draft, return your improved version of her draft: keep what works and change only what makes it better. Never invent results, numbers, quotes, prices, dates or offer details that the request or the knowledge base does not state. Return only the finished copy, with no commentary.
request.user:
Below is a transcript for a reel. I need a caption to go along with it. CTA should be for them to learn more about our Accelerator programs https://weddingindustryads.com/accelerate

Daniela: I heard somebody say recently that posting organically on social media is like leaving a glass of milk on the counter. 



Whitney: That's really gross, but it's not inaccurate, right? We have so little control over the organic algorithm and things move so quickly. I mean, even we are posting reels or posting carousels and we see really limited reach or visibility on those posts. 



Daniela: Totally. And that's where ads can really help create some stability, right?. Because you can guarantee that they're not only going to be given placements just to your organic following. And we all know that only a small percentage of business account followers actually see the content that you're posting organically before it just gets buried in the news feed forever. But if you're putting a little bit of budget behind that piece of content, you can ensure that the right people are going to see it at the right time and give it a lot longer shelf life.
